title: Ngā Kainoho o Ngā Māra e Rua
intro: I tētahi whenua i rere nui ai ngā manaakitanga, i mua i pārekareka tētahi hapori ki ngā hua o ngā māra ataahua e rua. He tohu ō rātou oranga ki te manaakitanga o te Atua, engari i huri te kōrero i te memeha haere o te whakawhetai, ā, ka puta he panonitanga hei tohu pumau mō te hunga katoa e whakaaroaro ana.
clues: He iwi mātou i manaakitia ki te whenua o te ngākau mārie, o te hua hoki.
I homai e tō tātou Ariki ki a tātou ngā māra ataahua e rua, he matomato, he hua i ngā taha katoa.
I whakahaua tātou kia whakawhetai, engari i whiriwhiria e tātou te kore whakawhetai, ā, tahuri ke atu ana.
Nā tētahi pā nui i pupuri ngā wai i ora ai tō mātou whenua.
I a mātou e tohe tonu ana ki tā mātou mahi hē, ka pakaru te tāhuna, ā, ka pā mai te waipuke.
Ko ā mātou māra i matomato i mua kua whakakapia ki ngā hua kawa, ki ngā tamariska, me ētahi rākau rōti.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: He hau nui mō ngā pō e whitu
He ua kōhatu mai i te rangi
He waipuke whakangaro mai i te pakaru o te tāhuna
He hamama nui mai i te rangi
trial.answer: He waipuke whakangaro mai i te pakaru o te tāhuna

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakakapia ā mātou māra ki ngā hua kawa me ngā rākau torutoru
I horomia tātou e te whenua i roto i te rū whenua
I hurihia mātou hei makimaki me hei poaka
I toremi mātou i roto i te waipuke nui
I whakangaromia mātou e te ua o ngā kōhatu
outcome.answer: I whakakapia ā mātou māra ki ngā hua kawa me ngā rākau torutoru

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
